'''Hot Work Power Bank''' is a {{gear|5|Kit}}gear item.

{{Item description|Independently designed by Endfield Industries and assembled by the AIC. This equipment improves the wearer's combat capabilities.|Equipment that features excellent fire resistance rating. 
The Hot Work Power Bank can be treated as miniature generators. It effectively converts ambient heat of high temperature environments into usable power for the user.}}
